entities.summary: Jean-Jacques Waltz, also known as "Oncle Hansi", or simply "Hansi" was a French artist of Alsatian origin. He was a staunch pro-French activist, and is famous for his quaint drawings, some of which contain harsh critiques of the Germans of the time. He was also a French hero of both the First and the Second World Wars.
